verdict.rationale: Mollie's own Subscriptions API lets users schedule recurring payments, which Mollie creates automatically at the specified interval. That API is exposed through the official hosted MCP server, so an AI-native user can set up these schedules via AI tools. Scheduling is limited to recurring payment charges, though; there is no general job or workflow scheduler. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, scheduling of non-payment operations (e.g., reports, payouts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
